checks.name: Three brief schemas preserve common inputs and reject incomplete submit
Creator submits selected brief; excluded fields never leak
AI and human handover preserve conversation context
Second HQ has no access to first HQ request queue
HQ rate update preserves snapshot; explicit revision updates quote
Other Creator cannot see the inquiry; owner accepts the quote
Accepted request converts to one HOTS-compatible dummy project
Reload retains requests, quote and support messages
Second HQ project dataset excludes converted projects from the first HQ
Converted project continues through resource scheduling, delivery, payment and archive
Direct HQ client request can be cancelled without a project
Unsent draft survives reload with type and common values
Storage failure keeps previous support state and shows an actionable error
Reset workspace can recover the accepted project without a second inquiry
Mobile service layout has no horizontal page overflow and keeps vendor theme
